He also discusses alleged device surveillance, account restrictions, and competition among AI companies. His central prediction is that security fears could motivate tighter regulation, platform consolidation, and reduced privacy or self-hosting. The source presents these points as commentary and speculation; several technical names and examples are unclear in the captions and require independent verification.
